title: The Dragon Republic
author: R.F. Kuang
summary: After the brutal war that ended the first book, Rin is a fugitive and an opium user. She allies with a warlord who wants to overthrow the empire and has foreign ships and a dragon.
readIf: you have read The Poppy War and want a darker, politically sharp sequel.
skipIf: you have not read the first book or dislike graphic war violence.
